career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automated approval combined with accountability for errors: the number of roles is declining while tolerance for mistakes is falling.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but automated approval combined with accountability for errors. Rules engines take over standardized credit decisions, while document fraud and exceptions allow little room for error; one missed check can bring personal accountability.
risks: Automated approval replaces standardized work
Document fraud is difficult to detect
Strong accountability for operating errors
Transparent end-to-end audit trails
Performance tied to metrics

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how much an engine can approve, people still verify documents, investigate fraud, and decide exceptions. Human responsibility cannot be removed entirely from credit decisions. This is career-exploration guidance, not a forecast or employment guarantee.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化审批 + 差错追责」——岗位在变少，容错在变低。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化审批 + 差错追责」——规则引擎接走标准化授信，但材料造假与例外处置容错低，一笔漏核就要担责。
risks: 自动审批替代标准化
材料造假难甄别
操作差错追责重
全程留痕透明
绩效与指标挂钩

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管引擎多能批，材料还是人核的、造假还是人查的、例外还是人定的——信用这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.label: Risk one: document-entry roles shrink
career_path_block.path: Move into classification and dispute resolution; earn advanced credentials

career_path_block.label: Risk two: policy volatility
career_path_block.path: Track policy continuously and serve as the client's external policy advisor

career_path_block.label: Risk three: price competition
career_path_block.path: Specialize in a product category and handle difficult or disputed declarations

career_path_block.label: Risk four: liability exposure
career_path_block.path: Keep strict records, use review workflows, and purchase professional liability insurance

career_path_block.label: Risk five: skill depreciation
career_path_block.path: Master AI tools and turn efficiency into your advantage

career_risk_cards.callout: The central risk is AI absorbing pure operations, not the disappearance of the occupation. Classification disputes and compliance accountability become more valuable.
career_risk_cards.fact: Single-window systems and AI classification tools are spreading worldwide, but clients still rely on people for classification disputes and penalty responses that carry professional responsibility.
risks: AI classification and single-window adoption reduce entry-level document roles
Fast-changing cross-border e-commerce policies create business volatility
Price competition among brokerages produces high volume but thin margins
Liability risk: classification or declaration errors can result in penalties
High substitutability: document-processing skills lose value

page.contract_project_risk_block: Over the next five years, Customs Brokers will look more like compliance advisors + dispute-resolution specialists. Systems calculate; people decide and carry responsibility.

responsibilities: Confirm product classification and calculate duties and taxes
skills: Use of AI classification and declaration tools

career_path_block.label: 风险一：录单岗位收缩
career_path_block.path: 转做归类与争议处理，考高等级资质

career_path_block.label: 风险二：政策波动
career_path_block.path: 持续跟踪政策，做客户的「政策外脑」

career_path_block.label: 风险三：价格战
career_path_block.path: 深耕垂直品类，做难单、争议单

career_path_block.label: 风险四：责任风险
career_path_block.path: 严格留痕、复核流程，买职业责任险

career_path_block.label: 风险五：技能贬值
career_path_block.path: 掌握 AI 工具，把效率变成自己的优势

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险核心在「纯操作被 AI 吃」，不在岗位——归类争议和合规担责越来越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 各国单一窗口和 AI 归类工具都在普及，但归类争议、处罚应对这类「扛责任」的活，客户仍要找人。
risks: AI 归类与单一窗口普及，初级录单岗位收缩
跨境电商政策变化快，业务波动大
报关行价格战，单量多但利润薄
责任风险：归类或申报错误可能被处罚
可替代性强：单证操作环节技能贬值

page.contract_project_risk_block: 未来五年的海关经纪人，更像「合规顾问 + 争议处理专家」：系统负责算，你负责定和扛。

responsibilities: 确认商品归类并核算税费
skills: AI 归类与申报工具使用

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Data Entry Keyers lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk comes from high-risk exposure and unclear accountability, not AI. People remain responsible for Data Entry Keyers judgments and final review; AI handles only structured tasks.
risks: Accountability and compliance-boundary pressure in data-entry work.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Break high exposure into what you can learn and control: methods are learnable, while process quality and compliance are controllable. Use this information for career exploration, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.

responsibilities: Create and execute data-entry work plans.
Take responsibility for the quality and risk of data-entry outputs.
Coordinate resources and drive delivery of data-entry projects.
Review and improve data-entry processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——数据录入员的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「高风险敞口 + 责任边界」——数据录入员的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Data Entry Keyers领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把高风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Data Entry Keyers相关的工作方案。
对Data Entry Keyers产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Data Entry Keyers项目交付。
复盘优化Data Entry Keyers流程与方法。

career_path_block.说明: Responsible for borehole quality and safety
Reduced by automatic logging and measurement while drilling

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are safety and injury, not AI. One operating error can ruin an entire borehole or injure someone.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are field safety and weather windows, not AI. Rigs are heavy equipment and subsurface conditions are hidden. Collapse, stuck pipe, or broken rods can waste a day, while crews endure extreme winter and summer weather.
risks: Field work has equipment and weather hazards
Income fluctuates with projects and rig days decline in slow seasons
Stuck pipe, collapse, and broken rods cause delays and losses
Occupational risks include noise, dust, and back and knee strain
Demanding conditions drive young workers away and age the workforce

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent automatic logging becomes, people still connect rods, adjust drilling fluid, and judge subsurface conditions. Data does not make the ground yield by itself.

responsibilities: Operate rigs to complete drilling work
Stabilize and clean holes and log samples
Record borehole and equipment operating logs
Maintain equipment and protect site safety
skills: Core and soil sampling and logging
Site safety management and emergency response

career_path_block.说明: 技术 + 安全双重责任
对整孔质量与安全负责
被自动编录与随钻监测压缩

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「安全与伤病」——一次操作失误可能毁掉整个井孔，甚至伤到人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「现场安全 + 天气窗口」——钻机是重型设备，井下情况看不见，塌孔、卡钻、断杆都可能让一天白干，冬夏极端天气还得硬扛。
risks: 野外作业安全隐患多，设备重、天气差
收入随工程波动，淡季台班减少
卡钻、塌孔、断杆等事故导致误工与损失
职业病风险：噪声、粉尘、腰膝劳损
行业苦累，年轻人流失快，队伍老龄化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管自动编录多聪明，钻杆还是人接的、泥浆还是人调的、井下还是人判断的——大地不会因为数据就自己让路。

responsibilities: 操作钻机完成钻进作业
执行护壁、清孔与取样编录
记录钻孔与设备运行日志
维护设备并保障现场安全
skills: 设备日常维护与故障排查

career_risk_cards.callout: The largest career risk is not AI alone but automation and platform-based oversight. Tools absorb routine entry work and monitoring moves to cloud platforms, while inspectors with field enforcement skills become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The largest risk is the combination of automation and platform-based oversight. Online monitoring and AI-assisted record checks absorb some routine inspections, while staffing changes with regulatory intensity. Remote sensing also moves initial site screening upstream.
risks: Online monitoring reduces routine inspections
AI replaces some record-comparison work
Staffing changes with policy cycles
Pressure from companies and local interests
Field safety risks

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable the system becomes, inspectors still decide whether a lead justifies a case, how to collect evidence on site, and what enforcement action is appropriate. Human judgment remains embedded in inspection work.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 平台化」——常规录入被工具吃、监测上云，有现场执法力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 平台化」——在线监测和 AI 台账核查吃掉部分常规巡检，且编制随监管强度波动；同时遥感把现场排查前置。
risks: 在线监测吃常规巡检
AI 台账替部分比对
编制随政策波动
企业与地方压力
现场安全风险

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那条线索立不立案、现场怎么取证、裁量怎么定，最后还是检查员的眼去查、嘴去谈、手去签——监察这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Shift toward data and technical skills
Requires public recruitment and offers high stability
Project-based work that varies with policy

career_path_block.路径: Remaining in physical patrol work only

career_risk_cards.callout: The main career risk is a limited ceiling, not AI. Work limited to physical patrols becomes harder with age and offers little protection from technical change.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are field hazards and a limited career ceiling, not AI. Wildfire response and extreme-weather work create safety risks, while frontline roles often offer limited advancement.
risks: Field safety risks from wildfire, extreme weather, insects, and snakes
Low income ceiling and limited pay growth in frontline roles
Advancement depends on public-sector positions and professional titles and can be slow
Remote locations limit services and children's education options
Workers without digital skills face pressure from drone and remote-sensing patrols

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how advanced remote sensing becomes, people must still reach muddy plots, judge conditions near a fire, and speak with residents. The core of this occupation is being present on the ground.

responsibilities: Carry out reforestation, stand improvement, and site preparation
Conduct sample-plot surveys and collect field data
Participate in fire patrols and initial wildfire response
Monitor pests, diseases, and wildlife and report findings
skills: GIS and drone operation are advantages

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「职业天花板」——如果只做纯体力巡护，既扛不住年纪，也扛不住技术转型。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「野外风险 + 职业天花板」——山火扑救、极端天气作业有安全风险，而基层岗位的晋升空间相对有限。
risks: 野外安全风险：山火、极端天气、蛇虫叮咬
收入天花板低，基层岗位薪资涨幅有限
晋升依赖编制与职称，路径长且慢
位置偏远，生活配套与子女教育受限
不学数字化工具者，巡护岗位被无人机与遥感挤压

page.contract_project_risk_block: 无论遥感技术多发达，森林的最后一公里——泥泞里的样地、火场边的判断、村民家门口的劝说——都需要有人用脚走到。这个职业的核心，是「人到了」。

responsibilities: 执行造林、抚育与整地任务
开展样地调查并采集野外数据
参与防火巡护与火情初期处置
监测病虫害与野生动物并上报

career_path_block.说明: Developing stage of a research career

career_risk_cards.callout: The main career risk is remaining a data-pipeline operator without developing judgment. Geneticists who design experiments, interpret clinical evidence, and use AI effectively can adapt to the changing research model.
career_risk_cards.fact: The largest risk comes from deep AI involvement in analysis. Variant annotation, data processing, and literature review are automating, which compresses pure analysis roles. Scientific direction, experimental design, and clinical interpretation still require professional judgment.
risks: AI takes over data analysis and compresses pure analysis roles
Intense research competition creates publication and grant pressure
Long training requires substantial time and financial investment
Clinical and industry positions are highly competitive
Genetic data carries serious ethical and privacy responsibilities

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can annotate variants in minutes and review hundreds of papers, but scientists still decide whether a mutation causes disease and which experiment should come next. Machine speed does not replace scientific judgment.

responsibilities: Analyze genomic data and interpret variants
Study associations between genes and disease
Write papers and provide clinical support

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只做数据流水线不做判断」——能设计实验、会临床解读、善用 AI 的遗传学家，才扛得住范式变革。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险来自「AI 对分析环节的深度介入」：变异注释、数据分析、文献综述被 AI 加速甚至自动化，纯数据分析型岗位被压缩；但研究方向的判断、实验设计和临床解读，仍需科学家的专业判断。
risks: AI 接管数据分析，纯分析岗压缩
科研内卷，论文与基金压力大
长学制高投入，成才周期长
临床与产业岗位竞争激烈
基因数据伦理与隐私责任重

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能几分钟注释完变异、帮你读几百篇文献，但「这个突变到底致不致病、下个实验该怎么做」——方向的判断，还得靠你的脑子。遗传学是探索生命底层的科学，机器的快，替代不了人的判断。

responsibilities: 设计并执行遗传学研究
分析基因组数据解读变异
撰写论文并参与临床支持
skills: 基因组测序与实验设计

career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest occupational risk is not AI, but "operation + safety" - in the factory you manage, if something goes wrong, someone will be held accountable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in the position is not AI, but "business cycle + safety responsibility" - order fluctuations directly affect the factory, and safety and quality accidents are heavily accountable.
risks: The business cycle is directly affected by the factory
Accountability for safety and quality accidents is heavy
Table data is compressed by AI
7×24 responsibility, be called at any time
Industry fluctuations affect preparation

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how accurate the production schedule is, whether or not to stop the machine tonight, how to schedule the work, how to save urgent orders, in the end, people still have to make a decision - at this end of the factory, the machines cannot fall to the ground.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「经营 + 安全」——你管的工厂，一出问题就追责到人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「经营周期 + 安全责任」——订单波动直接压到工厂，安全与质量事故问责重。
risks: 经营周期直接压到工厂
安全质量事故问责重
排表数据岗被 AI 压缩
7×24 责任，随时被 call
行业波动影响编制

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管排产多准，今晚停不停机、人怎么排、急单怎么救，最后还得人拍板——工厂这头，机器落不了地。

career_path_block.说明: Highest pressure across teaching, publications, and grants
Built through seniority and accumulated results

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but evaluation pressure and academic competition. AI changes how knowledge is produced, while passing up-or-out review and establishing a credible scholarly record determine whether someone remains in the field.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but up-or-out review and intense academic competition. Most universities use pre-tenure systems, requiring teaching, publications, and grants to advance simultaneously under immense pressure. Lower enthusiasm for law careers also affects enrollment, and some institutions face shrinking student pools and faculty lines, making competition severe.
risks: Up-or-out review: intense pressure and high attrition during evaluation
Academic competition: fierce rivalry for publications and grants
Enrollment volatility: declining interest in law programs has downstream effects
AI disruption: weakens the value of knowledge transmission alone
Uneven income: clear differences across institutions and fields

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can produce a credible paper draft, but only faculty can take responsibility for whether it frames a meaningful question and whether its claims withstand peer scrutiny. Academic integrity and intellectual depth remain human obligations to both scholars and students.

responsibilities: Teach law courses and complete instructional design
Conduct funded research and publish results
Contribute to program development and academic review
skills: Substantive legal knowledge and research methods

career_path_block.路径: 独立学院/职业院校教师

career_risk_cards.callout: 高校法学教师最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「考核与内卷」——AI 改变的是知识生产方式，而能否通过非升即走、能否在学术上立住，才是决定这行去留的根本。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「非升即走与学术内卷」：多数高校实行预聘长聘制，考核期里教学、论文、课题三线并进，压力巨大；同时法学专业就业遇冷传导到招生，部分院校面临生源和编制收缩，岗位竞争激烈。
risks: 非升即走：考核期压力大、淘汰率高
学术内卷：论文课题竞争白热化
生源波动：法学专业热度下降传导
AI 冲击：知识传授型价值被稀释
收入不均：院校与学科差异明显

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能写出一篇像样的论文初稿，但「这篇论文有没有真问题、这个判断经不经得起同行推敲」——这种学术诚信和思想深度，只有坐在书桌前的教师能对自己和学生负责。

responsibilities: 讲授法学课程并完成教学设计
指导本科生与研究生论文
开展课题研究并发表成果
参与学科建设与学术评审
skills: 法学专业知识与研究方法
AI 检索与数字化教学

career_path_block.说明: Exposed to pressure from AI scheduling tools
Decision role primarily assisted by AI

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but platform migration. Traditional channels are contracting faster than AI advances, so early transition into multiplatform operations offers greater stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but combined ratings and advertising pressure. When a prime-time program fails, the entire evening's ad inventory loses value. As short video diverts long-form traffic, traditional programming loses negotiating power.
risks: Traditional channels contract and television positions decline
Advertising-revenue volatility directly affects headcount budgets
Incorrect hit predictions create both ratings and commercial accountability
7×24 availability for major events and emergencies
AI tools gradually replace pure execution scheduling

page.contract_project_risk_block: Television employment structures and contract roles differ greatly. Platforms and MCNs commonly use project contracts. Compensation agreements should include programming results and document breakout-project shares explicitly.

responsibilities: Develop and maintain channel or platform schedules
Evaluate program performance and decide renewals or removals
Coordinate commercial slot placement with advertising departments
Monitor broadcasts and handle emergency schedule changes
skills: Emergency schedule changes and risk handling

career_path_block.说明: 可被 AI 排期工具挤压

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「平台迁移」——传统频道收缩得比 AI 快，早点转多平台运营才稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI 而是「收视与广告双重压力」——一档黄金档节目砸了，整晚广告位都跟着亏；长视频流量被短视频分流后，传统编排的议价权一直在缩水。
risks: 传统频道收缩，电视台编制岗减少
广告收入波动直接影响岗位预算
爆款判断失误要承担收视与商务双重责任
7×24 待命，重大活动与突发事件随叫随到
纯执行排片岗被 AI 工具逐步替代

page.contract_project_risk_block: 想进电视台体系，编制与合同制差异很大；平台与 MCN 多为项目合同制，谈薪时要把「排播业绩」写进考核，爆款分成要白纸黑字。

responsibilities: 制定并维护频道/平台播出编排表
评估节目表现并决定续播下档
对接广告部门完成商业点位排布
监控播出并处理突发换档

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but EDA + simulation. Platforms absorb manual work, while people who design architectures and integrate systems become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but EDA + design automation. Systems replace manual layout drawing and simulation runs, while people still provide architecture, cross-domain integration, and process tradeoffs.
risks: EDA absorbs layout work
Simulation replaces modeling
Large yield fluctuations
Tape-outs can fail
Cross-domain coordination is difficult

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, microsystems engineers still use their judgment, hands, and accountability to decide the architecture, how to package multiple domains, and which process tradeoffs to make. People cannot be removed entirely from chip development.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「EDA + 仿真」——手工被平台吃，会架构能集成的人反而更稳。
